text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
And the winner of the Satsuki Sho, the
first race
of the Triple Crown tour, is...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Dude, did you see that? I've never seen
anyone
run like her!

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text:
This is what makes the Triple Crown so
hype! You
never know who's gonna steal
the show!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Huff... Huff... Huff...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Aaaghhh! I looooost!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Sigh... Hah... So this is the Satsuki Sho...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: This is the Classics!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Trainer? What are you freaking out for?
You look
like someone just died.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Huh? What about it?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The tip of Tosen Jordan's shoe is stained
red with
blood.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Oh, crap...

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text:
Considering the state I saw you in
before, it's a
miracle it isn't worse.

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text:
The first aid you got on the way here
and taping
it up before the race must
have done you some
good. However...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Hey, Doc.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: How long until I get better?

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text:
It seems like you've made a habit out of
this kind
of thing, so it's going to take a
while to fully
recover.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Hmph...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, wasn't I just running toe-to-toe
with
everyone in the Satsuki?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
I know I lost and all, but didn't it feel
like we were
just getting started?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: So I... I just...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah.
choice_data_list: Did that make you want to run in m...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
I thought running in the Satsuki Sho, just
getting
a taste of the Classics, would be
enough...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
But once I crossed the finish, I suddenly
felt like I
could do something even
bigger.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Like I wanted to run more and more, that
I
couldn't let it all end here.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: I don't want to stop yet, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
I know I change my mind all the time, so
my word
might not mean much to you,
but...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: I really want to run in another race like the Satsuki Sho! I want to make it big!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
choice_data_list: ……Then we've got to treat it properly.
……Then we'll have to treat it prop...

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text:
In that case, you'll need to give it at
least six
months. We'll work hard to
make a full recovery
by then.

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text:
In other words, take it easy until
November. If you plan on racing, you
need to alert me so I can
check on your
nails.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Waiting until November means missing
the
Japanese Derby and Kikuka Sho, the
other two
legs of the Triple Crown.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
...So you're saying I might not be able to
run in
the Derby or Kikuka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text:
That's right. Depending on my
assessment before
you race, I may have
to forbid you from running.

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text:
That's something you'll have to accept if
you want
to get better. You do want to
keep racing, don't
you?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: ...Yes!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After getting briefed on the details of
the
treatment plan, the two of us leave
the hospital.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Some time has passed since the Satsuki
Sho, and Tosen Jordan has her first
scheduled checkup
coming up this
weekend.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Hey, you're Tosen Jordan's trainer.
Gotta hand it
to ya, that's quite the ruse
you pulled off.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. Thanks to you, hype for the Triple
Crown is
boiling over. Everyone's talking
about finding the
next Jordan.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
As a fellow player in this game, I gotta
say I look
forward to whatever you guys
have in store for us.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Patter, patter, patter, patter!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Trainer! They're out of control! What's
going on?!

text_block_list.name: Gyarus
text_block_list.text:
Jordan!
Jordan! Jordan!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Hot on the tail of a winded Tosen
Jordan, a group of unfamiliar
Umamusume come running into the

room.

text_block_list.name: Gyaru A
text_block_list.text: You have to see this article! We're obsessed! Please, we just want to chat!

text_block_list.name: Gyaru B
text_block_list.text: Oh, I can't! It still gets to me!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One of them shows us an online article
on her
phone.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
"Tosen Jordan: The Unbending Will
Behind the
Nails."

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's an article about Tosen Jordan, along
with a
photo of her from before the
Satsuki Sho, running
covered in mud.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It talks about how she trained hard to
deliver a stunning performance in the
Satsuki Sho despite
being held back by
her nails.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Though her medical emergency shocked the
crowd, she came back with a
knowing smile,
hinting that for her, the
best is yet to come.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Touched by the article's positive energy
and support for Tosen Jordan, I look at
the byline. It's
the reporter I spoke to
before the Satsuki Sho.

text_block_list.name: Gyaru B
text_block_list.text:
We used to hear all these rumors about
you, like how you always skipped
tryouts, or you'd never
win the Triple
Crown, stuff like that.

text_block_list.name: Gyaru C
text_block_list.text:
We totally thought you were one of us,
like, you
know, not the brightest, or
whatever.

text_block_list.name: Gyaru D
text_block_list.text: Sniffle... But then we saw this article and saw how you like, never gave up...

text_block_list.name: Gyaru E
text_block_list.text:
I can't even imagine how much your nails
hurt, but
you still showed up at the
Satsuki and slayed.

text_block_list.name: Gyaru A
text_block_list.text: Honestly, you're such an inspiration for gals like us! You're like our star!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Huh? To me?
choice_data_list: Looks like everyone has come to ad...
It looks like everyone looks up to...

text_block_list.name: Gyarus
text_block_list.text: Nodding furiously!

text_block_list.name: Gyaru B
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! I mean, you've got guts for days! I
wish I
could be half as cool as you!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
They all nod in unison. As for Tosen
Jordan...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Ha... Haha... You should've opened with
that!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
You scared me to death hunting me
down like
that, geez.

text_block_list.name: Gyaru A
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Oh, but we're like dead set on
rooting for
you in your next race!

text_block_list.name: Gyaru B
text_block_list.text:
So we wanted to ask if you already know
what
that's going to be!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Though racing may be possible
depending on her condition, the doctor
told us to take it easy until
November
and focus on recovery.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
So for the time being, we'll plan to start
racing again in November. As for a race
in that
timeframe that suits her
aptitudes...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A 2,500-meter G2 turf race held in
November,
many runners use it as a
stepping stone to the G1
races.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Wait, Argentina? Am I, like, going
abroad?

text_block_list.name: Gyaru C
text_block_list.text: Huh? How does that make any sense?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
International exchange races are held as
a part of
amity efforts. Similar races are
held in other
countries as well.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Ooh! Is that right?

text_block_list.name: Gyarus
text_block_list.text:
A big deal? Sounds like the perfect race
for
Jordan!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It feels a little like I've just taken new
students under my wing, but that aside,
our focus right now is making sure
Jordan's nails heal before the Copa
Republica Argentina.
